descriptionChirho: To catch up with and seize someone who is fleeing or being pursued, often in military or judicial contexts.
To extend to or arrive at a certain point, level, or destination, often of time periods, boundaries, or abstract goals.
To have one's hand reach far enough, indicating economic ability or sufficiency to afford something, especially in Levitical laws of offerings.
To acquire or gain possession of something desirable, especially joy and gladness overtaking the redeemed in prophetic promises.
To shift or displace something from its position, a distinct and rare usage of the Hifil stem indicating causative removal.
